definitions.explanation: Having broad and deep knowledge across many subjects. Used both as a noun and as a na-adjective to describe someone who is very knowledgeable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{博識|はくしき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a very knowledgeable person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{博識|はくしき}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}かされる→驚かす：01918_odorokasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm amazed by the teacher's depth of knowledge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}く→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{知|し}っていて→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{博識|はくしき}な⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You know so much about everything from history to science — you're truly erudite.

notes:
Composed of {博|はく} (wide/broad) + {識|しき} (knowledge), describing someone with wide-ranging knowledge. Used as both a noun and a na-adjective ({博識|はくしき}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {博識|はくしき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a knowledgeable/erudite person
- {博識|はくしき}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: display of one's extensive knowledge
- {博識|はくしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to be known for one's erudition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {物知|ものし}り: knowledgeable person — more colloquial and everyday
- {博学|はくがく}: erudition — very similar, slightly more academic in tone
- ⟦{教養|きょうよう}→教養：09788_kyouyou⟧: culture/cultivation — refers to refined knowledge and education
